name: Shakespeare in the Parks Apprenticeship Program
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
what_you_do: Join a summer ensemble. It tours Shakespeare plays for families. It plays in parks across Prince George's and Montgomery counties. Professional theater artists mentor you.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 16 and older. Spots are limited.
pay_detail: Paid apprenticeship. The pay rate is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The county page lists a March 1, 2027 deadline but does not say whether applications are open, and it has no application link. Email to ask before you plan around it.
how_to_apply: The page gives no application link. Email megan.merchant@pgparks.com to ask how to apply before the March 1, 2027 deadline.
notes: Confirm first. The county page has no application link. It does not describe audition steps. Maryland Department of Labor says work permits are required for all minors under 18 to work in Maryland. A permit is issued only after a job offer.
